errors.text_span: Es gibt zwei separate Balkendiagramme auf dem Bild
errors.evidence: The image shows a single horizontal bar chart with two distinct groups of categories on the y-axis (industries and company sizes), not two separate charts. They share the same x-axis and title.
The bar for 'Baugewerbe' ends at approximately 9%, not 5%.
The bar for 'Größere Betriebe (250+)' ends at approximately 36%, not 38%. Furthermore, this is not the highest value in this group; 'Mittlere Betriebe (50-249)' is higher at approximately 39%.
The bar for 'Kleinstbetriebe (1-9)' ends at approximately 19%, not 17%.
The description uses the figure caption for the purpose but omits the actual title displayed on the chart: 'Anteil an allen Betrieben in %'.
The description does not mention the units of the x-axis, which are percentages ('in %') as indicated by the chart title.
The description of the x-axis omits the tick interval, which is every 5 units from 0 to 50.

The description correctly states that the bars in the top section (industries) are sorted in descending order, but it fails to mention that the bars in the bottom section (company sizes) are not sorted by value.
